top_signals.title: US Futures Rally on Anthropic Record IPO; Trump, Xi, Putin Meet
top_signals.summary: US equity futures rise ahead of Anthropic's trading debut. Gray markets point to a jump above 20% when shares start trading. President Trump wraps up his trip to Asia with a meeting with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin. They agree to boost supply of global fuels during their trilateral meeting in Shenzhen. Lizzy Galbraith of Aberdeen discusses the implications of the meeting on "Bloomberg Brief."  Keith Lerner of Truist looks ahead to Anthropic's market debut. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Crude oil production in the most prolific basin in the United States has remained moderate despite the war premium that pushed prices to over $100 a barrel. alerts.title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
alerts.summary: Google said today it worked with industry partners to dismantle a botnet made up of more than 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that ship with malicious software which secretly rents the user's Internet connection out to strangers and conducts advertising fraud. Experts involved in the takedown say the action is likely to sever the botnet's access to more than 10 million additional compromised systems, including other Internet of Things (IoT) products such as Android-based healthcare devices and karaoke machines.
